name: Nova md-fixup
description: Format and fix Markdown files using Brett Terpstra's md-fixup tool

config.title: Executable Path
config.description: Path to the md-fixup executable. Leave empty to use PATH.

config.title: Wrap Width
config.description: Text wrap width in characters. Leave empty to use .md-fixup config file or md-fixup's default (60).

config.title: Skip Rules
config.description: Comma-separated list of rule numbers or keywords to skip

config.title: Format on Save
config.description: Automatically format Markdown files when saving

config.title: Reverse Emphasis
config.description: Use ** for bold and _ for italic (instead of __ for bold and * for italic)

config.title: Additional Arguments
config.description: Additional command-line arguments to pass to md-fixup

configWorkspace.title: Executable Path
configWorkspace.description: Path to the md-fixup executable. Replaces the global path for this project. Leave empty to use the global setting.

configWorkspace.title: Wrap Width
configWorkspace.description: Text wrap width in characters. Replaces the global width for this project. Leave empty to use the global setting.

configWorkspace.title: Skip Rules
configWorkspace.description: Comma-separated list of rule numbers or keywords to skip. Replaces the global list for this project rather than adding to it. Leave empty to use the global setting.

configWorkspace.title: Format on Save
configWorkspace.description: Automatically format Markdown files when saving.

configWorkspace.title: Reverse Emphasis
configWorkspace.description: Use ** for bold and _ for italic.

configWorkspace.title: Additional Arguments
configWorkspace.description: Additional command-line arguments to pass to md-fixup. Replaces the global arguments for this project rather than adding to them. Leave empty to use the global setting.
